title: Andorra la Vella & Andorra
dek: A Pyrenees valley capital for two, on foot and by mountain bus — old-quarter history, borda cooking, and a low-altitude lake walk timed around the country's own November trail advice.
verified: ⚠ Draft — Pass A researched 2026-08-20 for the Nov 5–9, 2026 trip. Confirmed against official/operator sources: entry rules (europa.eu, Wikipedia), Casa de la Vall hours (govern.ad museums), Direct Bus schedule (andorradirectbus.es), emergency numbers (visitandorra.com), IGI tax rate (e-tramits.ad). Re-check before travel: Casa de la Vall's Nov–Apr hours (seasonal switch each May), Caldea admission price (official site blocked automated fetch this pass — confirm at caldea.com), Direct Bus fares (dynamic), and the US State Department advisory level (travel.state.gov blocks automated fetch — needs a browser check).

entry.visa: Visa-free — no Andorran visa required for stays up to 90 days
entry.passportValidity: Valid at least 3 months beyond your planned departure from the Schengen area, and issued within the last 10 years
entry.note: Andorra has no airport or train of its own — every entry is overland through Spain or France, so it's those two countries' Schengen entry rules that actually apply at the border, not a separate Andorran one.
